description: Maps this grammar's node names onto canonical TreeKind names. Node names are the upstream qualified TreeKind with the dot dropped, so the map is close to an identity function and is generated from that rule rather than curated entry by entry — see test/projection.test.ts, which asserts that every non-token node this grammar can produce is either mapped here or listed in `ignored`. Token leaves need no mapping: every token this grammar produces is already named after its upstream TokenKind.

notes.JavaQName: Java-qualified names are parsed by a separate rule because their segment set differs, but the reference builds the same QName node for both.
notes.ExprHoleNamed: `?name` and `???` are one TreeKind upstream, distinguished by their token.
notes.\u26a0: Lezer's single error node. The reference has three recovery kinds, so this is measured in the recovery lane only — see docs/CONFORMANCE.md.
notes.EnumBody: The reference has no node for the braces around a group of declarations or rules; the children sit directly under the declaration. Same for the other entries in `flatten`.
notes.ExprQName: A name in expression position is a bare QName upstream, with no expression node of its own.
notes.TypeName: A type name is the same QName node the reference builds elsewhere; there is no Type.Name.
notes.PredicateAndArity: Declared at TreeKind top level, so it has no sub-trait prefix -- unlike every other Predicate.* kind.
notes.Expr: The reference closes Expr.Expr around every expression. It is not one of the wrappers ast/transparency.json elides -- at `d"..."` it holds the DebugInterpolator token beside its child -- so this grammar produces it rather than declaring it away.
notes.Argument: ast/transparency.json elides the reference's Argument, so the expected trees have the expression directly under the argument list; this one is declared transparent to match.
notes.Pattern: The pattern counterpart of Expr: the reference closes Pattern.Pattern around every pattern.
notes.PatternVariable: ast/transparency.json elides the reference's Pattern.Variable, leaving the Ident directly under the pattern; this one is declared transparent to match.
notes.TypeParameter: ast/unattachable.json records that no TreeKind.TypeParameter reference exists in the reference at all -- Parser2 only ever closes TypeParameterList, with Parameter nodes inside it. The canonical kind of the same name can appear in no tree from any input.
notes.TypeEffect: ast/transparency.json elides the reference's Type.Effect, so the expected trees hold the `\\` token and the type as siblings; this grammar puts the token outside the node so the same elision applies.
notes.TypeArgument: ast/transparency.json elides the reference's Type.Argument, so the expected trees hold the type directly inside the argument list.
notes.CommentList: Built by src/projection.ts, not by the grammar: comments are @skip tokens and Lezer cannot group skipped tokens under a node, so a run of adjacent comment tokens is regrouped at projection time the way Parser2.open() groups them.
notes.ExprHoleVariable: ast/transparency.json elides the reference's Expr.HoleVariable, leaving the Ident it wraps.
notes.ExprDebug: The reference holds the `d` token and the string beside each other under the enclosing expression; its own Expr.DebugInterpolator wraps only the string and is elided by ast/transparency.json.
